videos.overview: ""American Idol's"" most outrageous judge, SIMON COWELL, stops by. From the show ""Las Vegas,"" JOSH DUHAMEL pays a visit. The incomparable TINA TURNER is here. Today you'll meet our 2005 wedding couple as we kick off LIVE'S WEDDING WEEK. And a lucky viewer will be the latest winner of a Pontiac Montana SV6 when we play LIVE'S PONTIAC EXTREME VAN-A-DAY GIVEAWAY!

videos.title: Season 16, Episode 13
videos.overview: KEVIN JAMES talks about his new movie ""Hitch."" BRIAN McKNIGHT performs. We reveal expert tips on how to throw a themed bridal shower during LIVE'S WEDDING WEEK. And someone will walk away with one (or two!) Pontiac Montana SV6 sport vans during LIVE'S PONTIAC EXTREME VAN-A-DAY GIVEAWAY.

videos.title: Season 16, Episode 14
videos.overview: Comedian DAVID SPADE shares laughs from his show ""8 Simple Rules."" Regis and Kelly meet the WINNERS OF THE AMAZING RACE. And LIVE'S WEDDING WEEK bride is treated to a wedding dress fashion show. Plus, we'll have another winner of a tax-free Pontiac Montana SV6 in LIVE'S PONTIAC EXTREME VAN-A-DAY GIVEAWAY!

videos.title: Season 16, Episode 15
videos.overview: LIVE'S WEDDING WEEK concludes with the marriage ceremony of ""Live's"" 2005 wedding couple. We invite you to witness the nuptials as our studio is transformed into a spectacular setting and the deserving bride and groom make their dreams come true on live television.

videos.title: Season 16, Episode 16
videos.overview: They have a story that spans 30 years. They met as teenagers, but even as life continued to pull them toward one another, difficult struggles and circumstances prevented them from being together. After 14 years apart, Angela Collins and Bo Swartwout reunited as part of ""Live's Lost Love Week 2004"" and rekindled their feelings for each other. Now they return to celebrate their life-long love when they are married today on ""Live's Lost Love Valentine's Wedding."" Witness the climactic chapter to Angela and Bo's story as they begin their wedded life today on ""Live.""

videos.overview: ""Live"" comes to you from Disneyland Park today to kick-off ""The Happiest Celebration On Earth,"" a global celebration to salute Disneyland's 50th anniversary. The hosts also share some laughs with ""Two and A Half Men's"" JON CRYER, and BILL PULLMAN will discuss his six-hour event series ""Revelations."" videos.overview: Singer-songwriter MICHAEL BUBLÉ talks with Kelly and Ryan, and Michael Gelman’s trainer JASON D’AMELIO wraps up “Live’s Virtual Fitness. Kelly and Ryan interview actress KIM RAVER about “Grey’s Anatomy.

videos.overview:
TRACY MORGAN talks about the television series “The Last O.G.” and Grammy Award winner JEWEL performs. Plus, DR. JENNIFER ASHTON returns to talk about “COVID-19 Myths VS. Truths” and home treatments for viewers.

Kelly and Ryan will also speak with ICU nurse, Liz O’Rourke.

videos.title: Ty Burrel, Taraji P. Henson
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan chat with TARAJI P. HENSON (“Coffee & Kareem”) and TY BURRELL, and DR. WENDY BAZILIAN demonstrates tips for saving perishable food at home.

videos.title: Max Greenfield, Victor Rasuk, David Foster
videos.overview: The hosts speak with "The Neighborhood" star MAX GREENFIELD, actor VICTOR RASUK previews the new series “The Baker and the Beauty,” 16-time Grammy Award winner DAVID FOSTER performs, and MONICA MANGIN gives a how-to guide on “survival gardening.

videos.title: Ed Helms, Alessia Cara, Jeffrey Katzenberg
videos.overview: “Laugh with Live” begins as Kelly and Ryan welcome ED HELMS to talk about the film “Coffee & Kareem.” Also, ALESSIA CARA details her role in the film “The Willoughbys,” and JEFFREY KATZENBERG discusses the new streaming platform “Quibi.”

videos.title: Dove Cameron, Denise Richards, Sebastian Maniscalco
videos.overview: Actress DOVE CAMERON returns to “Live,” and actress and reality star DENISE RICHARDS discusses “The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills.” Plus, “Laugh with Live” continues with comedian SEBASTIAN MANISCALCO.

videos.title: Whitney Cummings, Kyle Richards, Laine Hardy
videos.overview: WHITNEY CUMMINGS gives an update on her life and stand up tour as part of “Laugh with Live,” KYLE RICHARDS (“The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills”) chats with Kelly and Ryan, and “American Idol” winner LAINE HARDY performs the song “Ground I Grew Up On".

videos.title: Cate Blanchett, Aloe Blacc, Wendi McLendon-Covey
videos.overview: CATE BLANCHETT details her role in the series “Mrs. America” and “Laugh with Live” wraps up with WENDI MCLENDON-COVEY from “The Goldbergs.” Plus, Kelly and Ryan talk to this year’s “LEGO MASTERS” WINNERS, and singer ALOE BLACC performs.

videos.title: Rob Gronkowski, Camille Kostek, Katy Mixon
videos.overview: KATY MIXON from the series “American Housewife” returns to “Live,” and DR. DORIS DAY shares tips for taking care of your skin (www.myclearskin.com). And “Live” celebrates Earth Day throughout the week with “Live Goes Green Week.”

videos.title: Pitbull, Josh Hutcherson, Science Bob
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan talk with music icon PITBULL about his latest single, “I Believe That We Will Win,” JOSH HUTCHERSON discusses the final season of “Future Man,” and SCIENCE BOB demonstrates an experiment to make homemade ice cream with kids.

Andy Grammer, Mark Consuelos, Skylar Astin

videos.title: Jane Krakowski
videos.overview: JANE KRAKOWSKI chats about the film “The Willoughbys.” “Coping with COVID Week” begins with DR. MICHAEL BREUS giving tips on how to sleep better while sheltering.

videos.title: David Boreanaz, Liza Koshy
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan catch up with actor DAVID BOREANAZ and talk about the series “Seal Team,” and LIZA KOSHY details the new Quibi dance series “Floored.” Also, AMY NOFZIGER shares advice for avoiding pandemic-related scams and frauds as part of “Coping with COVID Week.”

videos.title: Lionel Richie, Katy Perry, Luke Bryan
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan welcome “American Idol” judges LUKE BRYAN, KATY PERRY, and LIONEL RICHIE to discuss the reality singing competition. “Coping with COVID Week” continues with DR. BELISA VRANICH teaching breathing techniques to reduce stress and anxiety.

videos.title: Jimmy Kimmel, Beth Behrs
videos.overview: Late night host JIMMY KIMMEL returns to “Live,” and BETH BEHRS talks about the series “The Neighborhood.” “Coping with COVID Week” wraps up with tips for grooming while sheltering at home from hair stylist XAVIER CRUZ.

videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan chat with BETHENNY FRANKEL, MICHAEL BUBLE, and JEWEL.

Actress and star of “Dead to Me” CHRISTINA APPLEGATE returns to “Live.” Also, JASON MRAZ performs his song “Wise Woman.”

Kelly and Ryan spoke with Leigh Harting of 3 Daughters Brewing in St. Petersburg, FL whose brewery is making hand sanitizer during the pandemic.

videos.title: Dua Lipa
videos.overview: Singer-songwriter DUA LIPA talks with Kelly and Ryan about her latest album, “Future Nostalgia.”

videos.title: Mila Kunis, Ashton Kutcher, Hilarie Burton Morgan
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan chat with ASHTON KUTCHER and MILA KUNIS about how they’re helping with relief efforts, and the launch of “Quarantine Wine.” In addition, HILARIE BURTON MORGAN talks about her at-home series “Friday Night In with the Morgans”.

videos.title: Lin-Manuel Miranda, Phil Donahue, Marlo Thomas
videos.overview:
“Feel Good Friday” returns as Kelly and Ryan welcome playwright LIN-MANUEL MIRANDA back to “Live,” and MARLO THOMAS and PHIL DONAHUE share “secrets” to happier marriages and a happier life. Plus, Chef ERIC RIPERT makes “Grandma’s French Toast.” Also, the hosts share another “Good News! Story of the Day” and profile another “Helping Hero” making a difference.

Lin-Manuel Miranda has launched the #RaiseUp campaign to raise essential funds for immigrant communities affected by COVID-19.

videos.title: Daniel Radcliffe, Melinda Macht-Greenberg
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan chat with DANIEL RADCLIFFE about the interactive special “Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt: Kimmy vs. the Reverend.” Also, “Live’s Conquering the Q Week” begins with a home-schooling lesson from Dr. MELINDA MACHT-GREENBERG, PhD.

videos.title: Michelle Dockery, Lance Ulanoff
videos.overview: Actress MICHELLE DOCKERY returns to “Live” to talk about the miniseries “Defending Jacob.” Editor-in-Chief of Lifewire LANCE ULANOFF returns as part of “Live’s Conquering the Q Week,” with tips to make video conferencing easier.

videos.title: James Marsden, Farnoosh Torabi
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan discuss the new season of “Dead to Me” with JAMES MARSDEN, and financial expert FARNOOSH TORABI talks about quarantine money anxieties as “Live’s Conquering the Q Week” continues.

videos.title: Yara Shahidi, Daveed Digga, Dr. Jennifer Ashton

JENNIFER ASHTON talks about ending quarantine safely for “Live’s Conquering the Q Week.”

videos.title: Glenn Close
videos.overview: “Feel Good Friday” returns as Kelly and Ryan chat with GLENN CLOSE about the charity “Bring Change to Mind” and DR. EILEEN KENNEDY-MOORE shares advice on navigating re-opening fears as “Live’s Conquering the Q Week” wraps up.

videos.title: Laura Linney, Just Sam

Also, “Live’s You In The Q Week!” begins, with daily tips for taking care of yourself during quarantine. The week kicks off with DR. MELINA JAMPOLIS talking about self-care super foods.

videos.title: Debi Mazar
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan speak with DEBI MAZAR and DR. DORIS DAY shares self-care skin repair tips for “Live’s You In The Q Week!”

videos.title: Darren Criss
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan talk with actor DARREN CRISS about the series “Royalties,” and KATIE BROWN returns with DIY relaxation and meditation crafts as “Live’s You In The Q Week!” continues.

Also, MONICA MANGIN shares self-care bargains for “Live’s You In the Q Week!

videos.title: Steve Patterson
videos.overview: STEVE PATTERSON checks in, and Kelly and Ryan talk with another “Helping Hero,” and share a “Good News Story of the Day.” Also, “Live’s You In The Q Week!” concludes with “Yoga in the Q!”

Kelly and Mark chat with comedian DAVID SPADE about his role in the film “The Wrong Missy,” singer-songwriter LEANN RIMES performs “There Will Be a Better Day,” and barbecue expert MYRON MIXON shares grilling tips for “Live’s Memorial Day Barbie-Q!”

videos.title: Madison Beer, Keegan-Michael Key
videos.overview: KEEGAN-MICHAEL KEY returns to “Live” to talk about the show “Game On!” MADISON BEER performs the song “Selfish,” and “Live’s Summer Staycation!” begins with designer VERN YIP demonstrating how to get resort turndown service at home.

videos.title: Josh Gad
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan catch up with actor JOSH GAD and speak with him about the film “Artemis Fowl,” and “Live’s Summer Staycation!” continues with backyard fun and games for the whole family with MONICA MANGIN.

videos.title: Tracee Ellis Ross
videos.overview: TRACEE ELLIS ROSS discusses her role in the film “The High Note,” and lifestyle expert DARCY MILLER shows how viewers can virtually tour the world while being at home as part of “Live’s Summer Staycation!”

videos.overview: It’s “Live’s At-Home Prom” and Kelly and Ryan host a celebration of this year’s prom fashions, share viewer-submitted stories, and enjoy tunes from DJ PAULY D and an appearance by ADDISON RAE. Also, the band AJR joins in on the party with a performance of the song “Bang!”

videos.title: Amanda Peet
videos.overview: Actress AMANDA PEET returns to “Live” to talk about the series “Dirty John: The Betty Broderick Story.” Also, “Live’s Summer Safety Week” begins with ABC News Chief Medical Correspondent DR. JENNIFER ASHTON discussing emergency and routine medical safety during COVID-19.

videos.title: David Muir
videos.overview: Kelly and Ryan welcome DAVID MUIR to the show and DR. JENNIFER JELLISON shares information on pet safety as part of "Live’s Summer Safety Week".

videos.overview: Actor BLAIR UNDERWOOD returns to “Live,” and DR. JOHN WHYTE, Chief Medical Officer of WebMD, speaks with Kelly and Ryan about safe summer recreation for “Live’s Summer Safety Week.”
